risks.title: Cybersecurity and technology governance risks
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly identifies cybersecurity as a major risk with detailed governance involving the board of directors, audit committee, and a dedicated technology committee. The strength of language suggests significant and ongoing concern.

risks.title: Litigation and unquantifiable claims
risks.score_rationale: Litigation risk is clearly stated with inability to estimate potential loss due to the preliminary nature of proceedings and unspecified damage claims. Language indicates potentially material impact.

risks.title: Dependence on franchisees and franchise sales performance
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on franchisee sales for royalty and advertising revenues. Fluctuations in these sales have a direct and documented impact on profitability (franchise comparable sales down 4.8% in 2025).

risks.title: Intense competition in the quick-service restaurant sector
risks.score_rationale: The QSR sector is highly competitive. The decline in comparable sales of 4.7% globally and 5.6% in the US reflects competitive pressure affecting customer traffic dynamics.

risks.title: Volatility in commodity and labor costs
risks.score_rationale: Commodity and labor costs are critical factors. The 10-K documents a 1.8 percentage point increase in COGS/sales due to commodity costs, labor rates, and lower traffic.

risks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and consumer spending
risks.score_rationale: General economic trends and consumer spending levels directly influence results. Declining customer traffic is documented as a key factor behind sales declines in 2025.

ai_positioning.summary: The company WEN does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K report. The data provided focuses on the company's financial, operational, and technological aspects without explicitly addressing emerging AI technologies.
